ov: Freshwater relatives of lobsters, also called crawfish or crawdads. They live in streams, swamps, ditches and paddy fields, and most can’t tolerate polluted water.
df: Living or decomposing plants and animals, and detritus.

cf.tip: Crayfish are the lobster’s freshwater relatives.

fx: “Crayfish” comes from the Old French escrevisse, altered to end in “fish”.
notes: Group entry (aliases crawfish, yabby).
